jobs.title: Public Relations Communications Manager
jobs.summary: Own Canada's earned-media function, build proactive and reactive PR practices, manage media inquiries, develop integrated communications plans and secure brand features.
jobs.fit: Mile 27 PR leadership and AthletesCAN's primary media-contact role align with earned media, proactive story development and integrated communications planning.
jobs.gap: Automotive, marketplace or travel-sector experience is preferred; it is not presented as a strict requirement.

jobs.title: Communications Manager, Canada
jobs.summary: Lead integrated internal and external communications, executive and change communications, associate engagement, issues support, thought leadership and media-relations support.
jobs.fit: UJA senior-leadership counsel, campaign planning and digital content experience, alongside AthletesCAN media work, align with the broad communications remit.
jobs.gap: French is strongly preferred but not required; direct ownership of large-scale corporate change communications is not explicit in the resume details.

jobs.title: Communications Lead
jobs.summary: Lead national communications strategy, media relations, digital and content strategy, crisis communications, executive counsel, team leadership and athlete storytelling.
jobs.fit: AthletesCAN and Canadian Olympic Committee experience directly match national sport storytelling, media leadership and high-performance athlete communications; UJA adds senior counsel and editorial leadership.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for 10 years of progressive experience versus approximately nine documented; French is a strong asset but not required, and frequent travel is required.

jobs.title: Manager, Marketing & Communications
jobs.summary: Lead marketing strategy and execution for the Foundation's events portfolio, campaigns, social media and editorial planning in support of its $500M Here for Life campaign.
jobs.fit: Directly relevant to UJA's large-scale philanthropic campaign communications, donor storytelling, stakeholder engagement and hands-on campaign delivery.
jobs.gap: Events are the primary portfolio focus; the role has no direct reports and requires substantial hands-on project execution.

jobs.title: Corporate Communications Manager II
jobs.summary: Advise senior leaders and lead corporate communications initiatives across internal and external messaging, media relations, digital content and reputational issues.
jobs.fit: UJA senior-stakeholder counsel, strategic campaign communications, editorial judgment and AthletesCAN media experience align with integrated communications leadership.
jobs.gap: Experience supporting capital markets, wholesale banking or financial services businesses is preferred and is not established.

jobs.title: Manager, Pension Communications (12-Month Contract)
jobs.summary: Lead communications strategies and accessible content for pension plan members and stakeholders across Ontario's university sector.
jobs.fit: UJA's multi-stakeholder nonprofit communications and flagship content work, plus AthletesCAN's membership-association context, are directly transferable.
jobs.gap: Pension and financial-services knowledge is an asset; the role requires simplifying technical pension information, a subject area not established in the resume.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Athlete Marketing
jobs.summary: Lead national athlete marketing strategy, athlete portfolio, partnerships with teams, leagues and federations, athlete storytelling, content and a team of athlete-marketing staff.
jobs.fit: AthletesCAN and Canadian Olympic Committee experience provide strong Canadian sport-system knowledge, athlete relationships and media/content experience.
jobs.gap: The role emphasizes athlete portfolio ownership, brand marketing, partnership negotiations, budgets and team leadership beyond the communications remit documented in the resume.

jobs.title: External Communications Manager
jobs.summary: Support media relations, executive visibility and ghostwriting, thought leadership, PR agency management and crisis communications for a social-impact technology company.
jobs.fit: Mile 27 PR leadership, AthletesCAN media experience, UJA nonprofit context and executive-facing storytelling are relevant to external reputation and thought leadership.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for at least three years leading media relations or crisis communications for a B2B brand; that specialized track record is not established.

jobs.title: Marketing Communications Manager — Canada (6-Month Contract)
jobs.summary: Build Canadian storytelling across earned media, customer communications, content, thought leadership and social; manage external PR and social agencies.
jobs.fit: Mile 27 PR leadership, UJA editorial planning and AthletesCAN digital communications align with integrated storytelling, agency management and campaign measurement.
jobs.gap: SaaS and small-business/accountant audiences are a learning curve; direct technology-sector communications experience is not established.

jobs.title: Director, Communications
jobs.summary: Lead integrated communications, reputation, media, executive thought leadership, digital strategy and stakeholder engagement for the Faculty of Health Sciences; advise Faculty leadership.
jobs.fit: Jacob's MA in Applied Health Sciences, research-informed writing, UJA senior-leadership counsel and content leadership align with health-sciences reputation and research storytelling.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for at least 10 years' progressively responsible experience and senior leadership in complex organizations; Jacob has approximately nine documented years.

jobs.title: Communications Advisor II — Strategic Internal Communications
jobs.summary: Create employee stories, intranet and Viva Engage content, newsletters, editorial calendars and internal campaign measurement; support internal activation of sponsorships.
jobs.fit: UJA content calendars and editorial work, AthletesCAN communications, SharePoint familiarity and sport sponsorship context align well with the day-to-day work.
jobs.gap: This advisor-level position reports to a manager and asks for three years' experience, so it is below Jacob's target seniority despite the relevant work.

jobs.title: Philanthropy Communications Officer
jobs.summary: Produce donor proposals, stewardship materials, fundraising emails, patient-impact stories, executive and governance communications, and donor-event collateral.
jobs.fit: UJA's $78M+ annual campaign, donor storytelling, executive content and flagship publications are closely aligned with the Foundation's fundraising and stewardship communications.
jobs.gap: The Officer title and 2–3 year minimum experience place this below Jacob's target level; Raiser's Edge is also listed as a records tool.

jobs.title: Communications Specialist
jobs.summary: Deliver internal and external communications content across channels, reporting to the Senior Director, Communications.
jobs.fit: Jacob's editorial content, multi-channel communications, sport/nonprofit storytelling and senior-stakeholder experience align with the broad communications remit.
jobs.gap: The Specialist title is below target level and the posting gives limited detail on strategic ownership or leadership scope.

jobs.title: Marketing, Communications and Philanthropy Officer
jobs.summary: Support marketing, communications and philanthropy initiatives to strengthen public engagement and fundraising across VON's audiences.
jobs.fit: UJA fundraising communications and donor-facing content are directly relevant to the philanthropy component, with broad communications experience transferable to the role.
jobs.gap: The Officer title and salary indicate a role below Jacob's target seniority and compensation level.
